name: browser_task
description: Complete a bounded browser task using fast typed decisions. Prefer outcome-oriented goals. Stops before consequential actions and returns evidence, usage, and a confirmation request when needed.

goal.description: Observable final state to reach, including every user constraint. Describe outcomes, not a guessed click sequence.

start_url.description: Optional page to open before the task begins.

inputs.description: Caller-supplied values keyed by semantic names such as search query or departure airport. The controller never invents missing personal data.

allowed_origins.description: Origins the host permits this task to navigate to.

headed.description: Show Chrome. Useful for sites that block headless browsers or require user interaction.
